message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Contact | |---------|---------|------------|---------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak & Metrorail)** | 1 Airport Dr, Miami, FL 33126 | • Pets are allowed on trains **only in a carrier** (no loose pets).
• The station itself is pet‑friendly: you can walk your dog through the concourse, but pets must be leashed and under control.
• No pets in the waiting area or on the platform unless in a carrier. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [miamiintermodalcenter.com](https://miamiintermodalcenter.com) | ### Quick Tips - **Carrier‑only rule**: If you’re traveling on Amtrak or the Metrorail, keep your pet in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. - **Leash & control**: While walking through the station, keep your dog leashed and under control. - **Check schedules**: Some trains may have additional restrictions for pets, so double‑check the specific train’s pet policy before you travel. If you need a pet‑friendly station for a different rail service (e.g., commuter rail), the Miami Intermodal Center is the primary hub and is the most commonly used pet‑friendly station in the city.
